result:
Round 27 passes: all six checks (R27-1 to R27-6) hold against the published commit `6c956b4`. I found no bugs, and the checks ran on the real app (realVerified = true). TM-B29 (D-34) can be marked done, and the docs findings C-R25-03/04 are closed. I changed nothing in the repository: HEAD is still `6c956b4` and the working tree is clean.

- **R27-1, scope of the change:** the change from `c2c19a7` touches exactly the 8 planned files.
  - `file-store.ts` adds only the two new fields and `markPathsWritten`.
  - The test files only gain lines, so the existing tests (s1)–(s8) are unchanged.
  - `" as "` still appears 2 times in `MetadataPanel.tsx`, and no comments, `any` or `@ts-ignore` were added.
  - Whether the original change was made with Edit/Write only cannot be checked, because no transcript exists (B-R26-01). The task says this does not block a pass.
- **R27-2, red → green:** with the old source and the new tests, 210 passed and 6 failed: (s9), (s10), (s13), (s14), (s15) and (g1). The five UI tests fail because a stale value (`ACat`) is left in the store, not because of setup. (g1) fails because `markPathsWritten` doesn't exist in the old store. On `6c956b4` all 216 pass, and each new test passes when run alone.
- **R27-3, mutations:** all 12 deliberately broken variants were caught by at least one test, each by the test B expected. Nothing survived.
- **R27-4, full gate:** exit 0. Biome shows 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as on `c2c19a7`, and type checks are clean. Renderer tests 216/216, main 93/93, end-to-end 7/7, and 7/7 again with `--retries=0`.
- **R27-5, real app, old vs new build:**
  - **Timing:** the schema read started at 1.16 s, before the 3.05 s write finished. It replied at 7.16 s, after the save's own re-read, as the plan required.
  - **New build:** the form shows Category `R27Cat` both after the late read and after clicking b.wav then a.wav. ffprobe and music-metadata both read `ICAT=R27Cat` and title `R27T2` from the file.
  - **Old build:** the data loss reproduces. The form falls back to an empty Category, and the next save writes `ICAT=''` back to disk.
  - There were no page errors on either build, and neither reader shows an artist.
- **R27-6, docs:** every line reference I grepped points at the right code on `6c956b4`, and entries 3, 9 and 10 and the README row read as the task specifies. Entries 1, 2, 4 and 6 changed only their line numbers; that update was required because the code moved down 5 lines.

Two minor observations, both also present in the old build and not caused by this change:
- **C-R27-01:** clicking Done in the schema editor keeps the editor open until the schema read finishes. In the test it was still open 2 s after Done.
- **C-R27-02:** the empty new custom field is written to the file as `RNOT=''`, the same behaviour as the existing C-R1-01 finding.

Windows packaging is blocked because it is not available in the cloud; it was not part of this round. The JSON follows the task's schema exactly, so the two observations are only in the report.
